name: Skyboxes
description: The Skyboxes type of the library and its importer, for skies in your scenes: HDR and EXR panoramas, image panoramas, six-image cube maps, and cube maps unfolded into a cross or strip.

importers.name: skybox
importers.summary: Import HDR and EXR panoramas, image panoramas, six-image cube maps and unfolded cube maps as skyboxes.

options.name: layout
options.help: How a single image is laid out; automatic reads it from the image's shape.

options.name: all
options.help: Also import images in a folder that do not look like skies.
